standard.title: Aerial Bunched Cables — For Working Voltages Up to and Including 1 100 Volts — Specification
standard.description: This standard specifies the physical, dimensional, constructional, and performance requirements for single-phase and three-phase polyethylene (PE) or crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated cables with stranded aluminium conductors twisted over a central bare or insulated high-strength aluminium alloy messenger wire. These cables are designed for use as overhead distribution feeders (commonly known as the Aerial Bunched Cable or ABC system) operating on a.c. electrical distribution networks at working voltages up to and including 1 100 V.
standard.scope: This standard specifies the physical, dimensional, constructional, and performance requirements for single-phase and three-phase polyethylene (PE) or crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated cables with stranded aluminium conductors twisted over a central bare or insulated high-strength aluminium alloy messenger wire. These cables are designed for use as overhead distribution feeders (commonly known as the Aerial Bunched Cable or ABC system) operating on a.c. electrical distribution networks at working voltages up to and including 1 100 V.

supersedes: N/A (Developed as a new dedicated Indian Standard to establish uniform parameters for low-voltage overhead bunched cable systems)

amendments.summary: Formally expands the scope of the standard to explicitly cover single-phase systems in addition to three-phase a.c. systems. It also substitutes page 3, Clause 6.5 to establish that the size of the messenger conductor for single-phase and three-phase cables, its breaking load, and its maximum d.c. resistance must strictly comply with Table 3.

certification.description: Strict Statutory Mandatory Certification. Under the 'Electrical Cables (Quality Control) Order' issued by the Government of India, all Aerial Bunched Cables (ABC) for working voltages up to and including 1100 V must conform to IS 14255:1995 and carry the mandatory BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Manufacturing, importing, distributing, or selling uncertified overhead bunched cables is a statutory offense. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable to industrial electrical cables.
requirements: Every cable drum or its attached identification label must be marked with the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) under a valid licence issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards, alongside the manufacturer's licence number (CM/L).

Phase and street lighting conductors must consist of H2 or H4 grade stranded aluminium complying with IS 8130, conforming to flexibility Class 2. The size of the street lighting conductor must be 16 mm².

The central messenger (neutral) conductor must be made of heat-treated aluminium-magnesium-silicon alloy wires (containing approximately 0.5% magnesium and 0.5% silicon) conforming to IS 398 (Part 4). The conductor must be circular (stranded or compacted) and have a minimum of 7 strands. The direction of lay of the outer wire layer must be right-hand, and joints are strictly prohibited except those made in the base rod before final drawing.

The extruded crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) insulation must possess: a) Tensile strength of min 12.5 N/mm²; b) Elongation at break of min 200%; c) After air oven aging (135 ± 3 °C for 7 days), maximum variation in tensile strength and elongation must not exceed ±25%; d) Hot set elongation under load (at 200 ± 3 °C, 15 min under 20 N/cm² load) must be a maximum of 175%, and permanent elongation after cooling must be a maximum of 15%; e) Thermal shrinkage (130 ± 3 °C for 1 h) of max 4%; f) Gravimetric water absorption (85 ± 2 °C for 14 days) of max 1 mg/cm²; g) Volume resistivity of min 1 x 10^14 ohm-cm at 27 °C and min 1 x 10^12 ohm-cm at 70 °C.

The thermoplastic polyethylene (PE) insulation must possess: a) Volume resistivity of min 1 x 10^14 ohm-cm at 27 °C and min 1 x 10^12 ohm-cm at 70 °C; b) Tensile strength of min 10 N/mm²; c) Elongation at break of min 300%; d) Melt flow index (MFI) of max 3; e) Vicat softening point of min 85 °C; f) Environmental stress cracking resistance showing zero cracks visible to the naked eye.
The phase and messenger conductors (with a compatible protective barrier tape applied if required) must be insulated with XLPE or PE applied uniformly by extrusion.

Drums must be grouped into lots (same size and manufacturing conditions) and drawn randomly using random number tables in accordance with IS 4905. The sampling scale and allowed defectives must conform to Table 5: a) Lot size up to 50 drums (select 2, permissible defectives = 0); b) 51 to 100 (select 5, permissible defectives = 0); c) 101 to 300 (select 13, permissible defectives = 0); d) 301 to 500 (select 20, permissible defectives = 1); e) 501 and above (select 32, permissible defectives = 2). Failure of any acceptance test on a drum sample designates it as 'defective'.

Each drum must be clearly and indelibly stencilled or labeled with: standard reference (IS 14255), manufacturer's trademark, type of cable and voltage grade, nominal phase area, length of cable on the drum, direction of rotation of drum, gross mass, country of origin, and year of manufacture.
